words.translation: Memorial Day for Victims of Communist Dictatorship (February 25th)
February 25th (date of Béla Kovács's arrest by the Soviet authorities in 1947)
arrest and deportation of Béla Kovács, General Secretary of the Smallholders' Party, by the Soviet authorities (1947)
Memorial Day for Hungarian Victims of the Holocaust (April 16th)
April 16th (marking the 1944 establishment of the first ghettos)
ghettoisation: forcing Jewish citizens into ghettos in 1944
to deport, to take away by force
